name: REDCap survey RCE
tile_line: A public survey link is enough. Exploited, in KEV.
tldr: Anyone with a public REDCap survey link can run code on the server, no login. Exploit public since 1 Oct 2026, attacks reported 7 Oct, on CISA's exploited list. Upgrade to a fixed release now and check for signs of attack.
summary: REDCap is a research survey and data tool used by over 8,500 institutions. Palo Alto's Unit 42 reported attackers using the bug to install crypto miners, and CISA added it to its exploited list on 18 Nov.

affected.label: REDCap 13.3.0 or newer, unfixed
affected.text: The bug is in REDCap 13.3.0 and later. Fixed in 16.0.49 (LTS), 17.3.10 (LTS) and 17.4.4 (Standard). The CVE record lists only those three as fixed, so other branches have no fix.

affected.label: Attacker has a public survey link
affected.text: The attack needs one valid public survey hash (the `s=` value in a survey link). Securifera says these are easy to find through search engines, urlscan or the Wayback Machine.

affected.label: Attacker can reach the server
affected.text: Unit 42 describes attacks on public-facing REDCap servers. Public survey links are made to be shared with people who have no login.

do.label: Upgrade REDCap
do.text: Upgrade to 16.0.49 or 17.3.10 (LTS) or 17.4.4 (Standard), or a newer release. REDCap says it shipped the fix within two days of learning about the bug in September 2026. Downloads and release notes need a REDCap Community login.

do.label: Until then: limit public surveys
do.text: Securifera's stopgap: disable or restrict public surveys and block survey requests to the root dispatcher, `DataImportController` and `ParcelController`. Treat this as temporary.

do.label: Check for signs of attack
do.text: In web logs, look for survey requests with an encoded `__passthru` (such as `%2569ndex.php`) or `route=DataImportController:index` or `ParcelController:show`. Also check for unexpected changes under `temp/cache` and processes started by the web server user. Unit 42 saw miners running as `syslog-ng-…` with files under `/var/tmp/.syslog-…`.

sources.title: CISA KEV: added 18 Nov, due 21 Nov
CVE record (Securifera): 13.3.0 and later, fixed versions, CVSS 9.8
Unit 42: attacks installing XMRig miners; REDCap statement
Securifera: how the bug works, stopgaps, what to look for
REDCap: 8,547 institutions; Community site needs a login

changes.text: Corrected the headline: Unit 42 reported the attacks on 7 Oct; it didn't say they started that day.
